items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1962-01-18
items.q: That's a turtle back. Yeah. Turtle back. The best man. Yeah.

ctx.x: One like this one I have. That's what I say. I like to play by myself. I'd love to hear you play us over there. You ought to bring one one night and play it.
You know with a band. I'm a little out of practice you know. But I'll keep working with it. Uh huh. That's a turtle back. Yeah. Turtle back. The best man. Yeah.
The old gorge shape going like ukulele. Just like a violin just so you. Yeah. It's not in tune now.
